CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  Tuesday, September 21, 2021 - 5:30 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber
  425 South Mission Drive
  San Gabriel, California 91776

  Due to Executive Order N-25-20 members of the City Council may
  Teleconference into the meeting.

  Chin Ho Liao
  Mayor  Mark Lazzaretto
  City Manager
  Tony Ding
  Vice Mayor  Keith Lemieux
  City Attorney
  John R. Harrington
  Council Member  Julie Nguyen
  City Clerk
  Denise Menchaca
  Council Member  Kevin B. Sawkins
  City Treasurer
  Jason Pu
  Council Member

  Pursuant to State and County Directives, the physical access to the meeting has been
  suspended. To provide members of the public access to the meeting and an opportunity to
  comment on items on this Agenda, the following opportunity has been established:

  Public Comments

  Please email all public comments on items on this agenda only to cityclerk@sgch.org and
  include the following on the subject line of your email: PUBLIC COMMENT: 09/21/2021
  Special Meeting. The Clerk will read public comments into the record for up to the
  three-minute limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity,
  and discriminatory language, will not be read.

  Watch the Meeting Online
  Live broadcasts of the meetings are available using the following link:
  City Council Meeting Videos
  Spectrum cable: Live streaming on Channel 3, Public Access Channel.

Questions about this Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of

MINUTES OF SEPTEMBER 21, 2021
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Liao called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 5:30 P.M.
  on Tuesday, September 21, 2021, with all Council Members and staff participating by
  teleconference.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  John R. Harrington, Denise Menchaca, Jason Pu, Vice
  Mayor Tony Ding, and Mayor Chin Ho Liao.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, City Attorney Keith
  Lemieux, Chief City Clerk Sharon Clark, Human
  Resources/Risk Management Director Edward Macias,
  and Labor Counsel Steve Filarsky.

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT - None.

I  2. CLOSED SESSION

  A. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR (Government Code §54957.6)

  City Negotiators - City Manager Lazzaretto, City Attorney Lemieux, and Human
  Resources/Risk Management Director Macias, Labor Relations Counsel Steve
  Filarsky.

  Regarding the following Employee Organizations - San Gabriel Police Officers'
  Association, San Gabriel Police Management Group, San Gabriel Firefighters'
  Association, San Gabriel Fire Management Group and all Unrepresented Employees.

  No reportable action was taken.

  3. ADJOURNMENT

  The City Council meeting was adjourned at 6:22 P.M.

I  Respectfully submitted:
